subset.rationale: Vector3d/Matrix3d -- Eigen::Matrix<double,3,1> and <double,3,3>, the library's flagship concrete types -- bound HEAD-ON. This is the run the nb::exclude_ feature was built for: Eigen's facade methods return expression templates whose own facades mint ever-deeper specializations (transpose() -> Transpose<Derived> -> Transpose<Transpose<...>>; asPermutation() grows Matrix<N> to Matrix<N*N>), so unrestricted discovery DIVERGES, and walking some minted specs (NestByValue<expr>, SparseView under Eigen/Dense) is a hard error. With the expression/view/solver templates and Eigen::internal excluded, discovery converges to exactly 32 specs: the two seeds, Matrix<complex<double>,1,1>/<3,1> (from eigenvalues() declarations), and each one's CRTP facade chain (MatrixBase/DenseBase/PlainObjectBase/DenseCoeffsBase x3/EigenBase) -- which bind as REAL Python bases (the Tier-3 inheritance theme at Tier-5 scale: Matrix -> PlainObjectBase -> MatrixBase -> DenseBase -> DenseCoeffsBase<3/1/0> -> EigenBase, all isinstance-checkable). The bound member surface is the non-template facade API (norm/squaredNorm/sum/prod/mean/trace/determinant/coeff access via __call__ and __getitem__/setZero/setOnes/normalize/normalized/rows/cols/size, Vector3d's real (x,y,z) ctor, *=/ /= -> __imul__/__idiv__, streamability -> __str__). Eigen's arithmetic operators are function templates returning expression types -- intrinsically outside the binder's model (member templates bind only via all-defaulted default instantiation) -- so the eigentest fixture supplies the eager-value arithmetic (add/scale/dot/cross/matmul/matvec/transpose/inverse/solve/symmetric-eigenvalues), all taking/returning the BOUND Matrix types by value, exercising the registered-type caster path differentially.
skipped_features: expression-template returns (transpose/inverse/diagonal/block/head/tail/cwise*/replicate/reverse/asDiagonal/asPermutation/homogeneous/colwise/rowwise/real/imag/...) -- excluded via nb::exclude_; the eager-value equivalents are exercised through the eigentest fixture
solver/decomposition objects (LLT/LDLT/*LU/*QR/SVD/eigensolvers/Jacobi) -- excluded; solve exercised eagerly via the fixture's partialPivLu().solve()
Map/Ref views (raw-pointer semantics have no Python value story)

fixed-size convenience ctors on WRONG-sized specs (Matrix(x,y,z) is a plain member of EVERY Matrix with a size static_assert in its BODY -- lazily ill-formed, undetectable by reflection; excluded per-member by reflection, the exclude_ member-level escape hatch). Same mechanism for the handful of facade members whose bodies are lazily ill-formed for some bound spec (e.g. eulerAngles on a vector).
comma-initializer (operator<<(Scalar) -> CommaInitializer, excluded -- a C++ syntactic device with no Python equivalent)
templated arithmetic operators (return expression types; see rationale)
